# JIAN TOOLS

JIAN TOOLS is a leading manufacturer of precision carbide cutting tools and modular drilling solutions, based in Vadodara, Gujarat. We engineer high-performance tooling for demanding industrial machining applications, including structural steel, heat exchangers, heavy engineering, and automotive.

## Core Products
- Modular Crown Drills (1D to 12D)
- Solid Carbide Drills
- High-Performance Endmills
- Reamers
- Threadmills
- Custom Profile Tooling

## Technical Specifications
- Drill Diameter Range: 8.00 to 52.00 mm
- Hole Tolerance: H7 / H8
- Surface Finish: Ra 0.2 - 0.8
- Materials Machined: Cast Iron, Steel, Stainless Steel, Aluminum, Superalloys
